data.professional_title: Senior IT Project & Program Manager | Agile Delivery Leader
data.summary: Senior IT Project & Program Manager with 22+ years delivering mission-critical programs across Banking, Financial Services, and Cybersecurity.

responsibilities: Led delivery of enterprise cybersecurity and infrastructure programs aligned to SWIFT's strategic roadmap, owning scope, schedule, and quality across Agile teams following the Spotify Model.
Managed program-level risks, cross-team dependencies, and stakeholder communications across globally distributed teams.

Strengthened delivery governance by establishing a weekly program health dashboard for senior stakeholders, replacing ad-hoc status updates, and improving leadership confidence in delivery predictability.

Spearheaded the enterprise-wide adoption of SWIFT's mandatory independent assessment process, coordinating across global teams to achieve full compliance attestation ahead of annual deadlines — with zero non-compliance flags raised.
Led 3 Agile teams through Scrum adoption and continuous-delivery practices, improving sprint predictability and delivery throughput.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies, backlog management, and PI planning across teams, removing impediments to keep delivery on track.

Partnered with Product Owners and business stakeholders to deliver enhancements to Capital One's digital banking platform, improving customer self-service capabilities, and reducing manual processing time.
Delivered multiple cybersecurity and infrastructure COTS programs — ServiceNow, Tanium, NetMRI, IPAM, and Oracle Tuxedo — across the US, Europe, Hong Kong, and Kuala Lumpur.
Owned end-to-end delivery, risk mitigation, and production rollouts for globally distributed teams spanning multiple time zones, ensuring zero-defect go-lives.
Defined business requirements with stakeholders, translated them into project plans, and maintained continual progress reporting to team, customers, and the project office.
Coached and transformed 13 Agile Scrum teams (6–11 members each) across Retail Banking, AML, Basel, and Big Data programs — including Spark Pay, KYC, Fill the Lake, and Basel compliance initiatives.
Facilitated Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Grooming, Reviews, and Retrospectives, and coached both onshore and offshore team members in the Scrum framework.

experience.role: Project Manager / Engagement Lead / Transition Manager
responsibilities: Delivered Europe's largest data warehouse migration for Lloyds Banking Group — migrating 35 million Halifax bank accounts onto the Lloyds platform using DataStage — leading a 17-person offshore team and coordinating with client SMEs to deliver on schedule.

Managed banking transformation, application support, migration, and transition programs across Capital One, Lloyds Banking Group, and Nortel — spanning development, L3 incident management, and knowledge transition across offshore and onshore teams in India, the UK, and the USA.

Led offshore–onshore coordination and SLA delivery for Capital One's DDE data distribution platform — managing a team of 30, presenting daily/weekly/monthly status reports to the client, and ensuring L3 incident resolution and release governance targets were consistently met.

education.institution: Bangalore Institute of Technology, Bangalore University
